2607.25852.title: AngelSpec: Towards Real-World High Performance Inference with Speculative Decoding
2607.25852.paper_summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference without changing the target distribution, but no single drafting structure performs best across real-world workloads. Autoregressive multi-token prediction (MTP) is a lightweight, stable proposal mechanism, whereas block-parallel diffusion amortizes drafting latency over much longer candidate sequences; the better choice depends strongly on the output distribution. We present AngelSpec, a unified training framework for MTP and block-parallel speculative decoding that addresses this heterogeneity at three levels. At the training level, rather than fitting one universal drafter to a uniform data mixture, we co-specialize structure and data: the MTP drafter is trained on diverse conversational data for high-entropy open-ended chat, and the block-diffusion drafter on code and mathematics data for longer predictable continuations. At the architecture level, we propose DFly, a block-diffusion framework combining a hybrid target-conditioning backbone with a predecessor-conditioned autoregressive head, improving target-feature utilization and intra-block dependency modeling while keeping generation parallel. At the inference level, both acceptance length and verification cost vary with domain, request, online load, and hardware, so DFly treats verification as a shared batch-level resource: it reallocates compute toward high-confidence prefixes across requests and combines expected utility with a profiled cost model to adapt verification depth online. Across the Hy3 series, DFly raises the average accepted length on Hy3-A21B by roughly 30% and attains the highest average throughput at every tested concurrency from 4 to 64, a 1.98-2.40x speedup over autoregressive decoding and 10.5-11.8% higher throughput than DFlash. We release AngelSpec to support training and extending these methods.
2607.25852.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼加速了大型語言模型的推理，而不改變目標分佈，但沒有單一的草擬結構能在現實工作負載中表現最佳。自回歸多標記預測（MTP）是一種輕量級、穩定的提案機制，而區塊並行擴散則將草擬延遲攤銷到更長的候選序列中；更好的選擇在很大程度上取決於輸出分佈。我們提出了AngelSpec，這是一個統一的訓練框架，用於MTP和區塊並行推測解碼，並在三個層面上解決這種異質性。在訓練層面上，我們不再將一個通用草擬者擬合到均勻的數據混合中，而是共同專業化結構和數據：MTP草擬者在多樣的對話數據上進行訓練，以應對高熵的開放式聊天，而區塊擴散草擬者則在代碼和數學數據上進行訓練，以便於更長的可預測延續。在架構層面上，我們提出了DFly，一個區塊擴散框架，結合了一個混合目標條件的骨幹和一個前驅條件的自回歸頭，改善了目標特徵的利用率和區塊內依賴建模，同時保持生成的並行性。在推理層面上，接受長度和驗證成本隨著領域、請求、在線負載和硬體而變化，因此DFly將驗證視為一種共享的批次級資源：它將計算重新分配到高置信度前綴上，並結合期望效用與配置的成本模型，以在線調整驗證深度。在Hy3系列中，DFly將Hy3-A21B的平均接受長度提高了約30%，並在每個測試的並發性（從4到64）中達到了最高的平均吞吐量，較自回歸解碼加速了1.98-2.40倍，並且比DFlash高出10.5-11.8%的吞吐量。我們發布了AngelSpec，以支持訓練和擴展這些方法。
